scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

findings: Actual diff adds first-failure storage, its publisher and one finish-path invocation; existing helper status and safe results remain unchanged.

supervise initializes the complete result before every path; helper_capture assigns the captured value before returning. Storage copies the result by value and retains a static tag, avoiding borrowed stack lifetime.
Only the first failed shared load/first-boot helper is retained. Subsequent failures cannot overwrite it.
Publication precedes fault/final publication/powerdown and runs independently of safe. Publisher failure marks good false; it grants no success or retry.
Shared-helper streams remain bounded to 1024 bytes each. Existing stream_json bounds apply; direct lifecycle/resource/second-boot capture and the 4096-byte resource chunk protocol remain unchanged.

actual_evidence.observed: All eleven compiler/body commands exited 0, directly joined, groups absent, streams closed, no timeout or capture/retirement errors. Compiler stderr is empty.
actual_evidence.coverage: Ten controlled Linux helper children exercise actual supervise/helper_capture/shared helper. Original failure exports no console context; corrected failure exports three records. Two failures preserve the first. Successful saved captures remain byte-identical.
actual_evidence.bounds: Two full 1024-byte streams produce 2197-byte lines; observed header is 195 bytes. Each remains below PIPE_BUF 4096.

static_binary.verified: ELF64 x86-64 EXEC; no PT_INTERP or PT_DYNAMIC; dependency file names the exact changed source.

eligibility: Eligible input for the separately granted init-only staging step. Planned 61-member map, one changed init and 60 unchanged members must still be measured.
limitations: PID1 main and actual unsafe-retirement publication were not executed by these tests. Boot failure cause remains unknown. No stage, normalization, source-retirement counter, native execution, restoration or cycle credit.
provenance: Independent read-only exact source/diff and retained raw-evidence review. No tests, root actions, census or edits. Original failures and prior scope remain preserved.
